name: Dongyue Group Limited
summary: Dongyue Group Limited is an investment holding company producing, distributing and selling chemical products, mainly in the People's Republic of China. Its products include polymers, organic silicones, refrigerants, dichloromethane, polyvinyl chloride and liquid alkali, organised into Polymers, Refrigerants, Organic Silicone and Dichloromethane/PVC and Liquid Alkali divisions.
